pages.text: Radiation builds up as a $(bold)dose$() in RU. The rate is RU per second from every source within 16 blocks.$(br2)Carry a $(l:radiation/geiger)Geiger Counter$(/l).

pages.title: Sickness
pages.text: $(bold)100 RU$(): hunger, nausea$(br)$(bold)300$(): weakness, mining fatigue, half healing$(br)$(danger)600$(): 4 hearts lost, no healing$(br)$(danger)1,000$(): steady lethal damage
Symptoms lag the real dose by about 30 s. Milk doesn't help.$(br2)Away from radiation you recover about 1 RU every 10 s. Death resets the dose.

pages.title: Sources
pages.text: $(li)Running cores and spent rods$(li)Corium, fallout, Radioactive Ash, Reactor Debris$(li)Uranium ore$(li)Contaminated items and players

pages.title: Seeing It
pages.text: Above about 60 RU/s you see white-blue specks. Above 400 RU/s, $(danger)full blue flashes$().
